name: xflickr_quota_near_limit

query_condition.sql: SELECT key_id FROM "xflickr_metrics" WHERE metric IN ('quota_used_total','quota_limit') GROUP BY key_id HAVING max(CASE WHEN metric='quota_used_total' THEN value ELSE 0 END) >= 0.9 * max(CASE WHEN metric='quota_limit' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AND max(CASE WHEN metric='quota_limit' THEN value ELSE 0 END) > 0

description: Impact: A Flickr API key is above 90 percent of its hourly quota. Action: Check usage and prepare for throttling or key rotation.
